desc:
Hotel Night Shift (Anomaly)

Welcome to the night shift.

Check guests into the hotel, scan reservations, assign rooms, deliver supplies, watch the security cameras, and keep everything running until morning.
But some guests aren’t what they seem.
Spot suspicious behavior, investigate strange activity, and survive dangerous anomalies hiding throughout the hotel. Make the wrong decision and you might let something inside that was never supposed to get a room.
🏨 Check in and care for guests
📋 Inspect reservations for suspicious details
📹 Monitor security cameras
👻 Encounter unpredictable anomalies and events
🔦 Explore dark hallways with your flashlight
⚡ Use security equipment when things turn dangerous
💰 Earn cash and upgrade the hotel
👥 Work together with your team
🌙 Survive increasingly dangerous nights  
Pay attention. Trust your instincts. And don’t let the wrong guest in.
